title: TraceSpec: Understanding and Improving Speculative Decoding for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.41177v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents execute tasks through repeated model calls over evolving histories of reasoning, actions, and tool feedback. Aggregate speculative-decoding metrics merge these distinct decisions, providing limited guidance on where draft supervision is needed. We present TraceSpec, a framework connecting trajectory evaluation with adaptive draft training. It combines dynamic execution with fixed-prefix replay and introduces TraceSpec-Traj, a corpus of 10,000 training states and 2,500 test states spanning browsing and software engineering. Analysis of five speculative baselines reveals that aggregate acceptance can rise with context length while declining within matched late browsing actions. Workload and phase further distinguish these trends, motivating supervision guided by trajectory conditions. translated_title: TraceSpec：理解并改进面向大语言模型智能体的投机解码
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体通过在不断演化的推理、动作与工具反馈历史之上反复调用模型来执行任务。汇总式的投机解码指标将这些不同的决策合并在一起，对于在何处需要草稿监督所提供的指导十分有限。我们提出了TraceSpec，这是一个将轨迹评估与自适应草稿训练相连接的框架。它将动态执行与固定前缀重放相结合，并引入了TraceSpec-Traj——一个包含10,000个训练状态和2,500个测试状态的语料库，涵盖浏览与软件工程两类任务。对五个投机解码基线的分析表明，汇总接受率可能随上下文长度增加而上升，却在匹配的后期浏览动作中出现下降。工作负载与阶段进一步区分了这些趋势，这启发了由轨迹条件引导的监督方式。TraceSpec在中间的助手轮次上进行训练，并利用基于状态的、前缀感知的接受率估计来分配固定的预测预算。
tldr: 提出TraceSpec框架，通过结合动态执行与固定前缀重放、构建跨浏览与软件工程任务的轨迹状态语料库，揭示了汇总投机解码指标掩盖的分阶段性能差异，并实现基于轨迹条件的自适应草稿监督与预测预算分配。
en_tdlr: TraceSpec connects trajectory-level evaluation with adaptive draft training for speculative decoding in LLM agents, showing that aggregate acceptance metrics mask step-level declines and enabling state-conditioned supervision with fixed prediction budget allocation.
